sentence: This project studies how infants pay attention to emotional information in facial expressions and how that attention changes as they develop.
This project designs a wireless communication system that sends the meaning of a message instead of rebuilding it exactly, using AI.
This project builds software tools that use network flow methods to study how alternative splicing changes, using both short and long reads.
This project studies how metal nanoparticles and the oxide they sit on affect each other electronically, and how that changes turning ethanol into acetaldehyde.
This project measures how quaternary ammonium compounds used to clean indoor spaces react and what products they form.
This project studies how ultrasonic vibrations produce heat and bond fiber-reinforced polymer composites, using experiments and a finite element model.
This project builds arrays of optical ultrasound sensors that turn ultrasound waves into light a camera can record, to make 3D images.
This project builds software that uses deep learning to spot changes in how a person walks, using motion recorded by consumer headphones.
This project builds a robot system that uses computer vision to measure traits of tomato plants in large greenhouses, powered by a wireless charger.
This project studies how skin microbes and the immune system work together to help frogs fight a fungal infection.
This project builds tools that help quantum learning keep working when the noise on quantum computers changes over time.
This project supports a conference where researchers share work in computational geometry.
This project develops math methods that keep networks of robots and other connected systems working when some parts fail or send bad information.
This project uses neutrino experiments to search for hidden particles and forces that could link neutrinos to dark matter.
This project designs a way to compute on encrypted data from many users while keeping it private, even with malicious users or servers.
This project studies how waste from a shrimp aquaculture plant changes seashore biodiversity, including fish, macroinvertebrates and algae.
This project studies how to make large pieces of metal that contain nanoscale twin layers, so the metal is both strong and easy to form.
This project studies how limited nitrogen changes the way bromeliads photosynthesize, grow and invest in leaves and flowers.
